glosses: To make (someone or something) cool; to cool down.

examples.text: [T]he other [artery] goes to the lungs, to fetch air to refrigerate the heart.

glosses: To keep (something) cool by containing within a refrigerator.

examples.text: Please refrigerate your uncooked meats at or below 40° Fahrenheit.
